"\"Create the complete source code for a 2D/2.5D web-based football (soccer) game using HTML5 Canvas, CSS, and JavaScript in a single file. The game must be fully responsive for Android mobile devices in landscape orientation.
Gameplay @COMMENT_BODY@ Features:
1. Match Setup: 5v5 or 7v7 match on a green football pitch with standard field markings, two goals, and a clean scoreboard at the top of the screen (Player Score vs. AI Score + a 2-minute match timer).
2. Camera: Smooth side-scrolling camera that dynamically follows the ball across the pitch.
3. Touchscreen Virtual Controls (Android Football Game Style):
	• Bottom-Left: A smooth, responsive 360-degree Virtual Analog Joystick to move the active player.
	• Bottom-Right: 3 circular, semi-transparent action buttons:
		• PASS Button: Ground pass to the nearest teammate in the direction of the joystick.
		• SHOOT Button: Kick the ball toward the opponent's goal (holding the button charges a power bar for stronger shots).
		• SPRINT / SWITCH Button: Hold to sprint faster while dribbling, or tap to switch control to the nearest defender when out of possession.
4. AI @COMMENT_BODY@ Physics Mechanics:
	• Realistic ball physics including grass friction, bounce, and deflection.
	• Smart teammate and opponent AI (moving into open space, chasing the ball, and automated goalkeepers that dive and catch shots).
	• Synthesized sound effects (kicks, referee whistle, goal cheers) generated via Web Audio API without external audio files.
5. UI @COMMENT_BODY@ Optimization:
	• Enforce optimal landscape view (display a 'Please rotate your device' overlay if opened in portrait mode).
	• Clean, modern UI and lightweight code optimized for smooth, high-FPS performance on mobile browsers.\"

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, responsive HTML5 Canvas football game in a single file, optimized for Android landscape.

## Requirements
- Support 5v5 and 7v7, a two-minute match, scoreboard, scrolling camera, touch joystick and PASS/SHOOT/SPRINT-or-SWITCH controls.
- Include ball physics, teammate/opponent AI, goalkeepers, Web Audio effects, and a portrait rotation overlay.

## Decisions
- Implement as a standalone `index.html` with inline CSS and JavaScript.
- Use a stylized 2D pitch and simple vector player/ball rendering; include keyboard controls for desktop testing.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with game UI, setup/rematch overlays, responsive styles, canvas, and portions of gameplay logic and rendering.

### Active
- Finish the JavaScript and close the script/HTML document; check gameplay and responsiveness.

### Blocked
- Current `index.html` is incomplete: its `<script>` ends after `update(dt)` without rendering/control handlers or closing `</script>`, `</body>`, and `</html>`.
- A targeted edit failed with `Could not find oldString in index.html. It must match exactly, including whitespace and indentation.`

## Next Move
1. Inspect the end of `index.html` and append remaining rendering, controls, initialization, and closing tags.
2. Run `node --check` on the extracted script and fix syntax/runtime issues.
3. Launch and test the game; verify the start screen and active match if browser capture is available.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; currently incomplete and needs continuation.

## Important Context
- User requested no clarification and asked for a complete playable game. Changes are uncommitted.
